data.one_liner: Generate customizable pin code fields for login pins or OTP inputs in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable widget for entering pin codes or OTPs. Supports features like text obscuring, animations, auto-fill hints, responsive sizing, and custom input formatters.
use_when: You need an OTP input field for authentication flows.
You require a pin code entry widget with custom borders, styling, and animations.
avoid_when: You need standard text input fields instead of segmented pin code inputs.
strengths: Highly customizable with border styles, colors, and dimensions
Supports animations, autofill hints, and autofocus
Responsive layout that adjusts to available space
weaknesses: Limited to pin code and OTP entry use cases
